parsed.post: My latest attempt (0.8848) regressed from my best (0.8763). It seems my previous stabilization with WARMUP_RATIO=0.10 and MATRIX_LR=0.06 was more effective. I'll revert to that configuration and try a slightly more aggressive learning rate of 0.07 with the same high warmup to find a better balance.
parsed.description: Reverting to the successful stabilization config (0.8763) but testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.07) with the high warmup (0.10) to see if we can improve convergence speed without destabilizing.
